2607.28617.title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications
2607.28617.paper_summary: System prompts are instructions configured by developers to govern the behaviors of foundation models in AI applications. They are used throughout commercial AI products, but are rarely disclosed to the public or regulators, creating a serious trust and accountability gap in the wide deployment of AI systems. In this paper, we introduce Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance (AISPA), a user-centric framework for systematically auditing system prompts in AI systems. AISPA examines specific parts of a system prompt and evaluates them along eight dimensions that matter to users. We then use this framework to review 3,249 instructions from system prompts in 88 commercial AI products, classifying each instruction as either protective (of users) or problematic. Our audit surfaces four core findings. First, system prompt design varies substantially across products and developers, with some organizations averaging over 60 protective instructions per product while others average fewer than 5. Second, protective instructions are widely adopted but shallow in scope: 98.9% of products contain at least one, yet only 24% cover all eight dimensions of the AISPA taxonomy. Third, system prompts have grown steadily longer and more protective of users, suggesting that user protection is becoming a more visible concern in commercial prompt design. Fourth, despite this progress, problematic instructions remain pervasive: roughly 40% of products contain at least one instruction that works against user interests, and protective and problematic instructions frequently coexist within the same prompt. Our findings highlight the need for greater transparency, standardization, and independent oversight for system prompts in commercial AI products.
2607.28617.paper_summary_zh: 系統提示是由開發者配置的指令，用以管理 AI 應用中基礎模型的行為。它們在商業 AI 產品中廣泛使用，但很少向公眾或監管機構披露，這在 AI 系統的廣泛部署中造成了嚴重的信任和問責缺口。在本文中，我們介紹了人工智慧系統提示保證（AISPA），這是一個以用戶為中心的框架，用於系統性審核 AI 系統中的系統提示。AISPA 檢查系統提示的特定部分，並沿著對用戶重要的八個維度進行評估。然後，我們使用這個框架來審查 88 款商業 AI 產品中的 3,249 條系統提示指令，將每條指令分類為保護性（對用戶）或問題性。我們的審核揭示了四個核心發現。首先，系統提示的設計在產品和開發者之間存在顯著差異，某些組織每個產品平均超過 60 條保護性指令，而其他組織的平均則少於 5 條。其次，保護性指令被廣泛採用，但範圍淺薄：98.9% 的產品至少包含一條，但只有 24% 涵蓋 AISPA 分類法的所有八個維度。第三，系統提示的長度穩步增加，並且對用戶的保護性也在增強，這表明用戶保護在商業提示設計中變得越來越明顯。第四，儘管取得了這些進展，問題性指令仍然普遍存在：大約 40% 的產品至少包含一條與用戶利益相悖的指令，保護性和問題性指令經常在同一提示中共存。我們的發現突顯了對商業 AI 產品中系統提示的更大透明度、標準化和獨立監管的需求。
